description.zh-CN: Nomic 出品的本地大模型桌面客户端：完全离线跑开源模型，聊天、建知识库（LocalDocs）都不用联网，也不需要显卡（有显卡更快）。
description.en: Desktop app from Nomic that runs open models fully offline — chat and build LocalDocs knowledge bases without any API calls; works on CPU, faster with a GPU.

runtime.note: Self-contained Qt desktop app (no system Node/Python). Requirements from official sources: Windows builds need Intel Core i3 2nd Gen / AMD Bulldozer or better (ARM build supports Snapdragon/SQ1/SQ2), installer controller enforces macOS 12.6+ / Ubuntu 22.04+ (installer_control.qs, measured from source); docs list macOS 12.6+.

args: set -e; M=$(mktemp -d); hdiutil attach -nobrowse -mountpoint "$M" "$HOME/.aibox/cache/downloads/gpt4all-installer-macos-v3.10.0.dmg"; A=$(find "$M" -maxdepth 2 -name '*.app' -type d | head -1); "$A"/Contents/MacOS/* --silent; hdiutil detach "$M"; rmdir "$M"
install.notes: dmg contains the Qt IFW installer app; running its binary with --silent performs the non-interactive install. Source evidence (cmake cpack_config + component qs): target = /Applications/gpt4all (bin/gpt4all.app) plus symlink /Applications/GPT4All.app. TODO macOS real-machine verification (actual bundle name inside the dmg, Gatekeeper, --silent acceptance).

direct-install.label: Official direct install (GitHub Releases)
direct-install.note: Installer route: Windows runs the Qt IFW installer in silent mode into %USERPROFILE%\gpt4all (per-user, no admin), macOS mounts the dmg and runs the bundled installer; steps contain both platform packages and are filtered by machine arch (arm64 machines pick the -arm variant).

proxy-install.label: CN accelerated install (ghfast/gh-proxy channels)
proxy-install.note: Same packages; the download layer prefers proxy channels in CN and falls back to direct automatically.

local.label: Local models (free, offline, no key)
local.notes: GPT4All's core path is local inference — download models in the app (Chats → Load Default Model / Models page). configTarget is AiBOX's CONFIG write location (default ~/.config/<appId>/<appId>.json5), not a GPT4All-native file; the app itself keeps settings in its user data dir (%LOCALAPPDATA%\nomic.ai\GPT4All, official docs), macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/nomic.ai/GPT4All. TODO real-machine confirmation.

openai.label: Remote models — OpenAI / Groq / Mistral (v3.10+)
openai.notes: Release notes for v3.10.0 add a dedicated remote-provider tab (Groq, OpenAI, Mistral) in the Add Model page — keys are entered in the app UI (settings persistence lives in the app's user data dir / OS settings store, not a plain file AiBOX can write). configTarget is the AiBOX CONFIG write location for this app id; TODO real-machine confirmation of where GPT4All persists keys.

upgrade.notes: Check = local --version against the tag the daily probe records; upgrade = run the newer official installer over the existing install (same target directory), models and chats persist.

steps: Windows: run the Qt IFW maintenance/uninstall tool inside %USERPROFILE%\gpt4all (exact file name TODO real-machine confirmation), or delete the %USERPROFILE%\gpt4all folder and the Start menu / desktop shortcuts
macOS: run the installer's maintenance tool or delete /Applications/gpt4all and the /Applications/GPT4All.app symlink
Optional: delete the data directory (see residualPaths) to remove models, chats and LocalDocs collections
uninstall.notes: Default install is per-user (@HomeDir@\gpt4all), so no admin rights are needed to remove it; downloaded models can be several GB — keep them if you plan to reinstall.

risk.onUninstall: Downloaded models (often many GB), chat history and LocalDocs collections are stored in the data directory and are deleted with it — move them aside or back up before wiping. / 已下载的模型（常常好几个 GB）、聊天记录与 LocalDocs 知识库都存在数据目录里，清理即删除——请先挪走或备份。
